decision: Keep current scalar canonical validation for pure local sharpening and denoising. Whole-width bands accepted a graph rejected by the existing full tile path on both independent launches.

protocol.boundary: normal ImageEngines.editing.open/render(.settled,maxPixel:2400) through copyDisplayRGBA8, serialized on one GPU; two independent unique local-exposure states warm the resident source in each process; both target states visit once, operator order inverted in cycle 2
protocol.samples: 2 RAW x 2 ABBA cycles each x 4 processes per cycle x 2 operators x 2 states = 64 complete display byte digests; 8 exact responses per source/arm/operator. Timing P50 is arithmetic median, P95 nearest rank, equal to maximum at n=8. Peak is lifetime peak physical footprint inclusive of process startup and warmup; group physical samples n=4.
protocol.controls: Same sealed linked binary/working context, 512 MiB native policy, Apple unified Metal device and FlashRaw. Only RAWMASTER_QA_CANONICAL_LOCAL_MASK_BANDS changed between arms. This scratch normal-entry session warms the global source; app-wide first-from-cold and absolute global peak caps require separate official tests.

faults.realTerminalKernels: Both real shipped rmMaskComposite / rmMaskGrain with shipped neutral rmMaskLayerV7 and an injected adjusted sampler. This is adversarial input to the real terminals; a normal noise/sharpen RAW was not observed to contain these faults.
faults.rowAndPlan: At the omitted-first-cell rmMaskComposite site, a separate 8-pixel direct F32 row read was finite, while the whole original scalar graph failed. Inside rmMaskGrain, row samples 0 and 1 themselves contained infinities; the band route still accepted. All shader inputs, outputs and coverage bits are in the identical raw receipts. The measurements establish differing CI graph evaluations, without pinpointing the private optimizer pass.

checks.instrumentation: Only the missing-write check uses an otherwise byte-pinned transport twin. Last producer row or last reduction group deliberately omitted; validated expected domain/flags stay full. All shader, canonical, terminal and cancellation decisions use the original linked production transport.
